name: Beryl
source:
Energetic and strong-willed, she plans to take over her parents' workshop in the future.
Although her parents have drilled various techniques into her to achieve this, she doesn't have any friends her own age.
Her goal is to create original tools and spread them around. Her
only slight worry is that she isn't very physically developed.
